_what: Proposed NEW cards to fill the gaps (2026-09-03, Sophie: 'start proposing cards to fill in the gaps. one way is finding disparate cards that have something in common, and thinking of another example that also has that in common'). Each row: two cards that share one attribute and little else, and a third thing that shares it — written short, naming the thing, ready to be a prompt. Nothing is drawn until she hearts one. v1 = the first 30.
